Listen to this. An African American woman and a South American woman were driving to the restaurant but got into a fender bender on their way there. This resulted in a screaming match in the middle of the road. The South American woman got out of the car and started yelling at the other driver while the African American woman sat back embarrassed. Who was screaming?
A. The South American woman
B. Can't be determined
C. The African American woman
